title: Fixed-dimensional identity neighborhood for the weighted prefix hierarchy
statement: For each fixed n, there is a neighborhood of the identity in the unit-diagonal SPD cone such that C_t=J_t-(1/2)J_{t-1} satisfies C_t>=((t+1)mu/(2n))A^{-1} simultaneously for every 1<=t<=ceil(n/2). The neighborhood need not be uniform in n.
assumptions: Unit-diagonal SPD matrix sufficiently close to identity
open_objections: The proof supplies no radius uniform in dimension.
No Lean formalization, priority audit, or outside-human validation exists.
